in_marathi.name: Bhoomiyaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoomiyaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhoomiyaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Bhoomi’, meaning ‘earth’. This name is given to children in honor of the Earth Goddess, who is believed to provide nourishment, stability, and protection. Bhoomiyaa is a spiritual name with deep roots in Hindu mythology and symbolizes strength, resilience, and a connection to the natural world.
